apiRequests.query:
query GetExtensions($refreshCatalog: Boolean = false) {
  extensions(refreshCatalog: $refreshCatalog) {
    catalog
    platform
    extensions {
      ...ExtensionItemFields
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment ExtensionItemFields on ExtensionItemGql {
  id
  name
  description
  translations
  platforms
  state
  catalogVersion
  notAvailableReason
  progress {
    message
    percent
    __typename
  }
  installedVersion
  enabled
  ready
  message
  starting
  update
  failureMessage
  __typename
}
